failure_modes.title: Inaccessible measurement presentation
failure_modes.definition: Recipe uses only precise measurements without providing rule-of-thumb alternatives that would help beginners estimate   quantities.
examples: Mexican egg recipe specifies "1/4 cup onion, finely chopped (about 40g)" without alternatives like "about half a small onion"
Mediterranean pasta uses "350 grams penne" without mentioning "about 3 cups dried pasta"

failure_modes.title: Unclear Technique Guidance
failure_modes.definition: Recipe references cooking techniques without explaining how to perform or verify them, leaving beginners uncertain about   execution.
examples: Mediterranean salmon says "flakes easily with a fork" without explaining what a flake test is or how to perform it

failure_modes.title: Inaccurate Time Estimates
failure_modes.definition: Recipe's stated preparation time doesn't account for all necessary steps, particularly ingredient preparation, leading to    unrealistic expectations.
examples: Indian vegetable curry claims "30 minutes to prepare" but doesn't factor in chopping all vegetables (onion, garlic, ginger, tomatoes, carrot, potato, cauliflower, beans)
Recipe claims "15 minute dinner" but requires marinating meat for 30 minutes

failure_modes.title: Missing Serving Size Information
failure_modes.definition: Recipe fails to specify how many servings the ingredient quantities will produce.
examples: Recipe lists "4 large eggs, 1 small tomato" without indicating if this serves 1, 2, or 4 people
Pasta recipe doesn't specify whether "400g pasta" serves 2 or 4 people

failure_modes.title: Missing Equipment Specifications
failure_modes.definition: Recipe assumes availability of specific equipment without mentioning alternatives or noting the requirement upfront.
examples: Recipe requires "non-stick skillet" but doesn't suggest alternatives like cast iron with more oil
Recipe needs blender but doesn't mention this in ingredient list or suggest immersion blender alternative

failure_modes.title: Dietary Restriction Non-Compliance
failure_modes.definition: Recipe fails to fully honor stated dietary restrictions or doesn't verify ingredient compatibility.
examples: Vegetarian recipe suggests "parmesan cheese" without noting it often contains animal rennet
Gluten-free recipe uses "soy sauce" without warning to check if it's wheat-free
